images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
ONE square image of an unmistakably CARTOON STYLIZED 3D GAME MODEL of a bok choy plant, a cozy farm prop. Think carefully designed hand-sculpted animation-film shapes, chunky and graphic. NOT a photograph, NOT a realistic botanical render.
SHAPE DESIGN IS THE MAIN SUBJECT: exactly SIX large rounded spoon-shaped leaf lobes, short and wide with thick smoothly rounded edges, each like a softly bent solid sculpted leaf shape. A compact squat little rosette, width about 1.3 times its height. Short plump pale-jade stems gathered into a rounded base. Leaves open outward in a friendly flower-like silhouette, large broad simple surfaces, pleasing slightly asymmetrical arrangement. The top leaves have rounded tips, no jagged edges, no tiny leaves or realistic creases.
SURFACES: smooth MATTE moss-green / fresh sage green leaves, with broad softly painted gradients and just ONE short simplified central indentation per leaf. NO branching veins, NO thin lines, NO fine texture, NO speckles, NO leaf wrinkles, NO visible realistic fibres, NO intricate colour mottling, NO water droplets. Pale cream-green stems have equally clean broad shading. Natural softness, not shiny plastic, not transparent, not hard polygon facets, no face or eyes.
RENDER: clearly three-dimensional, soft ambient occlusion only at leaf overlaps, gentle studio diffuse light, quiet warm-gray solid OPAQUE background. Simple pleasant toy-like silhouette but believable leaf / plant colours. Front three-quarter view about 20 degrees from above, complete object including base, plenty of margin. Entire plant sharp. No pot, dirt, roots, grass, stage, labels, text, UI, other objects, multiple views or sheet. This is a stylized production concept for a small game object, not a product photo.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE square isolated 3D game cottage design.
Input 1 is ONLY a rural Jiangnan architecture and palette reference. Input 2 shows the REQUIRED LEVEL OF CARTOON SIMPLIFICATION: rounded chunky sculpted forms, broad shading, matte clean surfaces and minimal fine detail. Apply that simplification consistently to the cottage, not the green colour or botanical shape.
One modest squat grey-tile Jiangnan cottage with warm ivory plaster walls, brown timber structure, central wooden double door, a simple lattice window either side, shallow porch and two stone steps. Front-right three-quarter view about 20 degrees down. Complete roof and foundation inside frame, plain warm light-gray opaque background, gentle neutral studio light.
Make it visibly an artist-designed COZY CARTOON 3D GAME MODEL with believable material colours, NOT photorealistic building photography. Group the roof into a few broad rows of large thick rounded tiles; slightly rounded beams; clean thick window bars; warm broad wall planes. Subtle irregularity in proportions, modest rural pitched roof with gently curved eaves, no palace finials. Wood has only a few broad grain marks, plaster smooth with barely any age marks, stone foundation made of few chunky rounded blocks. NO chipped wall patches, no dense wood grain, no tiny roof damage, no moss texture, no micro-cracks, no gritty realism, no glossy plastic. Do not produce a flattened 2D illustration or angular low-poly triangle model.
No scenery, garden, terrain pedestal, plants, hanging signs, props, people, text, UI, multiple views or collage. Preserve the warm natural material feel with soft light and carefully designed volumes.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square single-object 3D cartoon farm asset reference. The attached plant sets the required rounded chunky simplification, smooth matte shading and low detail frequency. Keep this precise stylization level, but make a WHITE RADISH PLANT instead.
One short plump off-white daikon root with rounded shoulders, a clean tapered lower tip, and FIVE broad rounded gently lobed green leaves on short thick stems at its crown. The root and leaves are connected naturally. Stylize the root as one simple softly curved volume, only two shallow broad growth notches at most. Simplify leaves into thick slightly cupped sculpted shapes, smooth continuous outlines and one broad central fold only. NO tiny hairs, branched leaf veins, wrinkles, root fibres, photographic mottling, tears or wet gloss. Broad hand-painted moss/sage gradients, pale ivory root, tactile matte surfaces, believable plant colours with clearly cartoon proportions. NOT a photorealistic vegetable, not plastic, not a flat drawing, no face or eyes.
Full plant and full root visible, elevated three-quarter view, centered with generous margin, soft neutral studio light and a solid opaque warm-gray background. No soil, pot, other plants, scenery, pedestal, text, arrows, UI, multiple stages or collage. Complete root is shown for design; it will be mostly buried when placed in the game.

Use case: stylized-concept. One square isolated 3D CARTOON GAME PROP reference.
The attached stylized plant defines the simplified rounded form language and broad matte shading. Translate that same detail density into a small earthenware jar; do NOT transfer the plant's colour or shapes.
Exactly one squat warm terracotta-brown clay storage jar, large smooth rounded belly, short wide neck with thick rolled lip and clear dark opening, two rounded sturdy lug handles connected to upper shoulders, stable gently flattened bottom. Slight handmade asymmetry, broad soft orange-brown gradients, a few very faint broad wheel bands at most. Chunky coherent silhouette, smooth slightly worn edges, softly sculpted solid forms. Material should read as matte clay with natural warm colour and restrained shading. NO grainy pores, gritty microtexture, detailed chips, cracks, elaborate glaze, photoreal pottery photograph, glossy plastic, pattern, lettering, plants, lid or contents.
Single complete object centered with generous margin, three-quarter view about 18 degrees from above showing opening and both handle attachments, soft neutral studio lighting, faint contact shadow, solid opaque warm-grey background. No other props, terrain, stage, text, UI, multiple views or collage.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate ONE 16:9 full-bleed 3D cozy farming game screen with a CHINESE PAINTING art direction, not a poster or a painting hung on a wall.
Input image 1 is the USER-APPROVED COMPOSITION: preserve its comfortable wide diagonal viewing distance, about 30 degrees down, a complete miniature farm with cottage back-right, gate left, six-ish rectangular crop patches central foreground, stone paths, bamboo rails, water and small bridge right. Maintain real 3D depth and clearly visible wall sides, plant volumes, near/mid/far relationships so the camera could move closer to a field. Do not convert it to a frontal flat painting or a top-down farm grid.
Subsequent inputs are TRADITIONAL PAINTING REFERENCES ONLY for brush lines, restrained colour washes, material treatment and atmospheric spacing. Do NOT copy their birds, flowers, inscriptions, seals, ageing, stains, watermarks, paper frame or exact compositions.
Keep friendly rounded simplified silhouettes and broad readable forms. NO realistic leaf veins, pores, dense wood grain or photographic texture; no glossy molded plastic either. The image should look like a living 3D Chinese illustrated miniature. Crop patches must remain clear and visually separable; no ink cloud covering interactive land. All objects belong to one coherent world.
HUD stays tiny and functional: bottom three quiet ivory buttons with exactly “播种” “浇水” “收获”; upper-left basket “0”, upper-right sun “16:30”. No additional text, title, calligraphy, seals, arrows, inset, split-panel or collage. No humans or animals.

DIRECTION A, GONGBI-INSPIRED LIGHT COLOUR: delicate selective dark tea-brown and muted green contour brush lines along roof edges, beams, leaf silhouettes and stone boundaries; line weight varies gently rather than uniform thick toon outlines. Fill volumes with translucent-looking layers of warm ivory, sage, muted mineral green, soft ochre and pale teal, inspired by traditional flower-and-bird painting. Sparse fine structural strokes, absolutely no return to dense botanical detail. Surfaces have soft painted tonal transitions, subtle pigment accumulation at edges rather than hard PBR specular reflections. Keep the volumetric softness of rounded stylized 3D objects. Gentle warm daylight without golden cinematic glare. Distant hills are airy pale colour washes, river calm with generous clean stretches. Foreground about 75% explicit volumetric game scene, 25% painterly treatment; texture attached to objects, not a yellow old-paper filter over the screen. Calm, refined, playful Chinese courtyard with readable farm operations.
